title: DreamLake skill metadata (skill.json)
description: One per skill directory. name must equal the directory name. docs lists the pages that CI fetches into reference/; each entry is a page URL on docs.dreamlake.ai, cli.dreamlake.ai or viz.dreamlake.ai, without .md and without a trailing slash (the site root is the only URL that ends in a slash).

name.description: Skill name; equals the directory name.

description.description: One sentence: the user goal this skill owns.

requires.description: Skills installed together with this one; every name must exist in this repository.

docs.description: Page URLs fetched as <url>.md into reference/<site>-<slug>.md.

tools.description: Runtime the scripts in tools/ need, or null when there are none.

packages.description: pip package names the tools import.
